criteria.rationale: Seeding remains synchronous; this change adds no shared state, goroutines or lifecycle ownership.
The neutral schema-v2 template resolves a review plan after install; update and force-install preserve recorded adoption and instance overlays.
The reviewed stamp returns on unreadable or malformed policy, preserves unknown fields through the raw document and distinguishes absent keys from deliberate empty values.
The registered producer invokes actual install, update and force-install entrypoints in Git fixtures rather than testing only the template.
Successful atomic writes retain the existing bounded contract-adoption log; the added policy-level record contains only contract ID and date.

Fresh installs stop inheriting repository dates and overlays; absent-only seeding leaves existing instance decisions unchanged even under force. Legacy schema-v1 fallback is explicitly out of scope and remains tracked.
Full Go tests and vet passed; template parity and install tests cover both the distributed bytes and the resulting instance to avoid same-day coincidence masking inheritance.
The spec now cites the registered integration producer for R2, declares its matrix artifact, preserves historical attestations and gives the open migration follow-up canonical ownership.
The installed policy resolves a plan and update preserves choices. Surface-check passed with the explicitly retained containing-module reachability warning; no finer path coverage is claimed.
R1 and R5 are pinned by exclusion and embedded parity tests; R2 and R3 by real CLI scenarios; R4 by schema-valid neutral policy and fresh plan resolution. Strict requirement trace passes.

The resumed increment registers the missing integration producer and reconciles its trace, assessment and evidence. Runtime changes reviewed remain limited to neutral distribution and additive stamping; instance adoption and v1 migration are not changed.

Removing foreign dates and automatic overlays prevents imported exemption boundaries. Raw-key presence protects explicit empty decisions and force-install cannot replace recorded choices. No credentials, dependencies or remote operations are added.
